question:
Select the figure that will replace the question mark (?) in the following figure series.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e821b47f6f24db178bf588ebc66309fcb4c624ed412f47ffb3ee0c74ed113cad.png]
solution:
The figure that will replace the question mark (?) in the following figure series is as shown below :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/69d09bd192249c216f89df48f2b8364fb00b55358a7d98fa94262d12a0b06176.png] 

Figure 1 to Figure 2 → [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/8c5a0d528876d5c4c4883c638f030c223b0385079d777f8a61b0a47b03e99e64.png] moves two boxes clockwise and [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f8abde1c9f2f67e86b3ae89a57295f84749ea3d6ec7600f9451e09f36658502f.png] moves one step down wards.

Figure 2 to Figure 3 → [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/8c5a0d528876d5c4c4883c638f030c223b0385079d777f8a61b0a47b03e99e64.png] moves two boxes clockwise and [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f8abde1c9f2f67e86b3ae89a57295f84749ea3d6ec7600f9451e09f36658502f.png] moves one step down wards.

Figure 3 to Figure 4 → [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/8c5a0d528876d5c4c4883c638f030c223b0385079d777f8a61b0a47b03e99e64.png] moves two boxes clockwise and [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f8abde1c9f2f67e86b3ae89a57295f84749ea3d6ec7600f9451e09f36658502f.png] moves top box of same column.

Figure 4 to Figure 5 → [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/8c5a0d528876d5c4c4883c638f030c223b0385079d777f8a61b0a47b03e99e64.png] has to move two boxes clockwise and [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f8abde1c9f2f67e86b3ae89a57295f84749ea3d6ec7600f9451e09f36658502f.png] has to move one step down wards.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 4".**
